PAGE STRUCTURE:

- State: let neurons=[], branches=[], synapses=[], pulses=[], adj=new Map(), synapseKeys=new Set(), branchId=0, spawnTimer=0, paused=false, simTime=0, vignette=null.

- const gui=new dat.GUI({width:270});
- Folder 'Growth': add(params,'neuronCount',3,6,1).name('neuron count'); growthSpeed 0.2..8 step 0.1 name 'branch growth speed'; maxDepth 1..7 step 1 name 'max branch depth'; splitChance 0..1 step 0.01 name 'branch split chance'; curvature 0..1 step 0.01 name 'branch curvature'; maxBranchLength 30..200 step 5 name 'max branch length'.
- Folder 'Synapses': synapseThreshold 5..60 step 1 name 'distance threshold'; synapseGlow 0..30 step 1 name 'glow strength'.
- Folder 'Pulses': pulseSpeed 0.2..6 step 0.1 name 'pulse speed'; pulseFrequency 0.1..8 step 0.1 name 'pulse frequency'; pulseBrightness 0.2..3 step 0.1 name 'pulse brightness'.
- Folder 'Visuals': addColor bgColor name 'background color' with onChange(rebuildVignette); addColor branchColor name 'branch color'; addColor accentColor name 'accent branch color'; addColor synapseColor name 'synapse color'; addColor pulseColor name 'pulse color'; add showScanlines name 'scanlines'; add showVignette name 'vignette'. Open Growth and Visuals folders by default (fGrowth.open(); fVis.open()).
- Root (above folders or after): gui.add(params,'regenerate').name('regenerate network'); gui.add(params,'clearCanvas').name('clear canvas'); gui.add(params,'pause').name('pause/resume animation');

SECTION 3 — NEURON GROWTH:
- regen(): branches=[], synapses=[], pulses=[], synapseKeys.clear(), adj.clear(), branchId=0, pulses cleared; neurons=[]; const n=Math.max(3,Math.min(6,params.neuronCount|0)); for i<n create neuron near center: angle random*TAU, radius 40+random*120, {x:W/2+cos*r, y:H/2+sin*r}. For each neuron spawn 2 starter branches via addBranch at the neuron position with random angles roughly opposite (a and a+PI+random jitter), depth 0.
- addBranch(x,y,angle,depth,width): if branches.length>=MAX_BRANCHES return null; push object {id:branchId++, x, y, angle, depth, parent:null, width: (width !== undefined ? width : Math.max(0.8, 3.2-depth*0.45)*(0.8+Math.random()*0.5)), len: params.maxBranchLength*(0.45+Math.random()*0.65)*(depth===0?1:(0.6+Math.random()*0.5)), grown:0, done:false, accent:Math.random()<0.22, drift:(Math.random()-0.5)*0.06, pts:[{x,y}]}; return branch.

For each branch with done=false: active=true; const step=params.growthSpeed; b.angle+=b.drift+(Math.random()-0.5)*params.curvature; b.x+=cos(b.angle)*step; b.y+=sin(b.angle)*step; b.pts.push({x:b.x,y:b.y}); b.grown+=step; occasional mid-growth side branch: if b.depth<params.maxDepth && branches.length<MAX_BRANCHES && Math.random()<0.012 → child=addBranch(b.x,b.y, b.angle+(Math.random()<0.5?1:-1)*(0.6+Math.random()*0.7), b.depth+1, b.width*0.65), if child child.parent=b. When b.grown>=b.len: b.done=true; if b.depth<params.maxDepth && branches.length<MAX_BRANCHES && Math.random()<params.splitChance → spawn kids = Math.random()<0.4?2:1 children at (b.x,b.y) with angles b.angle ± (0.35+Math.random()*0.6)*(0.7+Math.random()*0.6) (one each side for 2 kids), width b.width*0.72, depth+1, set their parent=b.

SECTION 4 — SYNAPSE DETECTION:
- findSynapses(): if synapses.length>=MAX_SYNAPSES return; pairwise over all branches i<j (tip endpoints a.x,a.y vs b.x,b.y), skip if a.parent===b||b.parent===a; squared distance vs params.synapseThreshold*params.synapseThreshold; dedupe with key (a.id<b.id ? a.id+'_'+b.id : b.id+'_'+a.id) in synapseKeys Set; on new synapse push {a, b, phase:Math.random()*TAU} and register adjacency: adj.set/get arrays for a.id and b.id each pushing {s: synapse}. Cap at MAX_SYNAPSES.

SECTION 5 — PULSE ANIMATION:
- updatePulses(dt): spawnTimer+=dt*params.pulseFrequency; while spawnTimer>=1: spawnTimer-=1; if synapses.length && pulses.length<MAX_PULSES → pick random synapse s, push {s, t:0, dir:Math.random()<0.5?1:-1, sp:0.8+Math.random()*0.5, hop:2+((Math.random()*3)|0)}.
- Advance each pulse: p.t+=p.sp*params.pulseSpeed*dt. Pulse travels by linear interpolation between synapse endpoint branches (dir 1 = a→b, dir -1 = b→a). When p.t>=1: arrived branch = (p.dir===1 ? p.s.b : p.s.a); if p.hop>0: candidates = (adj.get(arrived.id)||[]).filter(o=>o.s!==p.s); if any → p.s=random candidate.s; p.dir=(p.s.a===arrived?1:-1); p.t=0; p.hop--; else remove pulse (splice). This lets sparks chain across the network over time.

SECTION 6 — RENDERING (one render() function, called each frame):
- Background: fill full canvas with params.bgColor; then radial gradient from center (inner radius 40, outer W*0.62) color GLOW at center to transparent 'rgba(16, 26, 58, 0)' at edge, with globalAlpha 0.8+0.1*sin(simTime*0.6) subtle breathing, then reset globalAlpha 1.
- Grid + scanlines (if params.showScanlines): strokeStyle=SCAN, lineWidth=1, single beginPath: static faint grid lines every 80px (vertical+horizontal), plus horizontal scanlines every 4px scrolling slowly (offset=(simTime*12)%4), stroke once.
- Branches: lineCap/lineJoin round; for each branch: col = b.accent ? params.accentColor : params.branchColor; ctx.strokeStyle=col; ctx.shadowColor=col; ctx.shadowBlur=7; ctx.lineWidth=b.width; strokeSmooth(b.pts).
- strokeSmooth(pts): quadratic midpoint smoothing — beginPath, moveTo pts[0]; for i=1..length-2 quadraticCurveTo(pts[i], midpoint of pts[i],pts[i+1]); lineTo last point; if pts.length<2 draw a tiny 0.01px line so round caps show a dot; stroke.
- Synapses: for each synapse compute live endpoints from s.a,s.b (they may have moved), mid=(a+b)/2, pulse=0.5+0.5*sin(simTime*3+s.phase); ctx.strokeStyle=ctx.shadowColor=params.synapseColor; ctx.shadowBlur=params.synapseGlow*(0.5+0.5*pulse); globalAlpha=0.35+0.4*pulse; thin lineWidth=1 line from a tip to b tip; fillStyle same color; glowing node arc at midpoint radius 1.8+1.6*pulse; reset globalAlpha=1 after loop.
- Pulses (electric sparks): ctx.strokeStyle=ctx.fillStyle=ctx.shadowColor=params.pulseColor; ctx.shadowBlur=16*params.pulseBrightness; for each pulse: A=(dir===1? s.a : s.b), B=(dir===1? s.b : s.a); head at lerp(A,B,p.t), tail at lerp(A,B,max(0,p.t-0.25)); draw short trailing lineWidth 1.5 segment tail→head with globalAlpha 0.9 plus filled arc head radius 2.2*params.pulseBrightness; reset alpha.
- Vignette: if params.showVignette, fillRect with cached radial gradient (center radius W*0.40 → edge W*0.72, from hexToRgba(params.bgColor,0) to hexToRgba(params.bgColor,0.55)).
- hexToRgba(hex,a): parse hex → `rgba(r,g,b,a)` string.

SECTION 7 — MAIN LOOP + INIT:
- rebuildVignette() defined and called once at init.
- regen() called at startup.
- let last=performance.now(); function loop(now){ requestAnimationFrame(loop); const dt=Math.min(0.05,(now-last)/1000); last=now; if(!paused){ simTime+=dt; updateGrowth(); findSynapses(); updatePulses(dt); render(); } } — when paused the last frame simply freezes.
- requestAnimationFrame(loop) at the end.

SYNTAX REQUIREMENTS: valid, self-consistent vanilla JavaScript; all helper names defined before use at call time (function declarations hoisted are fine); no leftover TODOs; no console errors; balanced braces; file saved completely."}
